body:
百万英镑模组（Million Pound Mod）
作者：权威潘大杨（Bilibili UP主）

本模组新增了多种以"英镑"为主题的趣味物品，包含：

百万英镑：经典的百万面额纸币
零英镑：面额为零的幸运纸币
拼多多英镑：百亿补贴风格，仅差0.01提现
一百亿英镑：超大面额的巨额纸币
百万应力：特殊变体版本
信封 & 密封信封：用信封 + 任意英镑合成密封信封，右键按住1.5秒拆开，随机获得对应英镑！右键英镑物品可查看高清纸币大图。
Million Pound Mod adds 7 fun themed items to Minecraft, inspired by the classic short story "The Million Pound Bank Note." Craft an Envelope with any pound note to create a Sealed Envelope — hold right-click to tear it open with satisfying sound effects and reveal the contents inside! Each pound item features a unique design: Million Pound, Zero Pound, Pinduoduo Pound, Ten Billion Pound, and Million Stress. Right-click any pound item to view its full-resolution texture in a detailed fullscreen viewer. Lightweight and vanilla-friendly — just some good fun for your world.

Items (7 total): Envelope, Million Pound, Zero Pound, Pinduoduo Pound, Ten Billion Pound, Million Stress, and Sealed Envelope. How to craft: Combine Envelope + any pound item → Sealed Envelope (shapeless recipe). Hold right-click to open and get both the envelope and the pound note back. Right-click detail view: Pound items support a full-screen texture viewer — inspect every pixel up close!

MC 1.21.1 | NeoForge 21.1.233
Author: PanDaYang / 权威潘大杨 (Bilibili UID: 3493142732998844)
